description: MainActivity.java is the primary activity for an Android quiz application, managing quiz creation, question flow, interaction with a wearable device via GoogleApiClient, handling DataItems and Messages, and updating the UI based on user responses and wearable feedback.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main Activity managing the quiz logic, UI, and communication with a wearable device.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Represents a quiz question, its answers, index, and conversion to DataRequest for transmission.

methods.name: addQuestion
methods.description: Collects user inputted question and answers, adds to quiz, updates UI.

methods.name: readQuizFromFile
methods.description: Loads quiz questions from a JSON file and adds them to the quiz.

methods.name: addQuestionDataItem
methods.description: Enqueues or immediately sends a question DataItem to the wearable device.

methods.name: setNewQuestionStatus
methods.description: Updates the UI to display a new question with 'unanswered' status.

methods.name: updateQuestionStatus
methods.description: Updates UI when a question is answered, coloring it green/red and updating stats.

methods.name: markQuestionLeftBlank
methods.description: Marks a question as unanswered due to deletion, updates stats.

methods.name: askNextQuestionIfExists
methods.description: Sends the next question DataItem or ends the quiz if none remaining.

methods.name: sendMessageToWearable
methods.description: Sends a message via Wearable API to connected nodes.

methods.name: resetQuiz
methods.description: Resets quiz state and UI, deletes DataItems, prepares for a new quiz.

methods.name: clearQuizStatus
methods.description: Clears UI and resets quiz counters and states.

methods.name: deleteDataItems
methods.description: Deletes a list of DataItems from Google's Data API.
